text:
alex: FYI nightly integ is red on hosted-api -> streaming+toolcall tests. failing in the last step when the tool payload arrives through the proxy. attaching log paste below.

ci-bot: nightly-build #372 failed: hosted-integration (shard 12/38) — auth OK, streaming chunk boundary error during tool call.

alex: log snippet:```
2024-11-12T03:21:10Z ERROR tool_runner - json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
... next chunk header: "9\r\n{\"tool\": \"search\", \"args\": { ... } }\r\n0\r\n\r\n"
2024-11-12T03:21:10Z WARN proxy - unexpected chunked EOF from upstream
```

sara: is this a regression from the runtime change yesterday (88a1d2c)? anyone repro locally?

mike: I can try a local run, but quick question — do we see truncated chunk sizes or extra bytes? log looks like the chunk header and JSON body are misaligned. could be the proxy or the streaming encoder.

lina: repro steps that hit the same failure for me: set HOSTED_API_URL to staging, then run:```
pytest tests/integration/test_tool_stream.py::test_tool_call_stream -k hosted -q
```
I also captured raw tcpdump and saw a missing CRLF between two chunks (looks like upstream wrote `\r\n` then immediately closed).

sara: @eng-infra can we rerun just shard 12 (the one failing) and keep logs verbose? low flake but blocking release.

eng-infra-bot: rerun scheduled: nightly-hosted-integ shards=[12] keep-logs=true -- queued on infra workers.

alex: if we need a quick local hit, you can replay with curl:```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOSTED_API_KEY" \
  "https://staging.redwood-inference/api/v1/stream?model=test&tool=search" \
  --data-binary @payload.ndjson
```
payload.ndjson should include streaming preface + tool invocation frame. the failure shows up when we pipe through our proxy (nginx LB + lua chunk coalescer).

mike: just ran the rerun command locally with same env and got the JSONDecodeError too. attaching quick diff that might be related:```
- chunk_writer: flush after each write
+ chunk_writer: buffer small writes into 8k coalescer
```
this was introduced in runtime patch 88a1d2c.

sara: ok let's bisect before rolling back. alex, can you start a quick git bisect on runtime between v1.14.0 and HEAD and run the failing test as the check?

alex: starting bisect now. simple check is `pytest tests/integration/test_tool_stream.py::test_tool_call_stream -q` — I'll post the first bad commit if it reproduces on CI.

ci-bot: rerun completed: shard 12 finished — still failing (same stack). logs: https://ci.redwood/372/logs/shard12

lina: I dug into the proxy lua code — looks like we only append CRLF after the first N chunks, which can leave the previous chunk header dangling when coalescing occurs. sending a tiny patch to test.

mike: tagging @sara for priority — if fix is small we can hotpatch in: patch candidate `proxy/lua/chunk_coalesce: append CRLF unconditionally after header`

sara: don't hotpatch without test. if we can add a unit that simulates coalescing + chunk split, that's safe. priority: flaky blocking release -> +1.

alex: bisect update: first bad commit is 88a1d2c (the runtime buffering change). reproduces locally when proxy coalescing is on. marking as P0 for next rollout.

eng-infra-bot: test job queued: staged-verify/proxy-coalesce-fix (will run against staging).

mike: proposed short-term mitigation: in our integration test harness, set PROXY_CHUNK_BUFFER=0 to avoid coalescing — reduces flake while fix lands. anyone opposed?

sara: ok to set as temporary in CI; add a PR to revert after fix lands. please add note in the PR description about risk.

alex: PR to add env override to CI pipeline: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ci/pull/402 — will set PROXY_CHUNK_BUFFER=0 for nightly-hosted-integ until patch merges.

lina: confirmation: my staging run with the lua patch + unit test passes local harness. pushing patch for review.

sara: thanks all. final ask before closing thread: eng-infra, once patch merges, please rerun full nightly and confirm no more toolcall stream JSONDecode errors in shards 8-15. tag this thread. :white_check_mark:

eng-infra-bot: acknowledged — will rerun full nightly post-merge and report back.

mike: I'll prepare a short blurb for release notes about the transient buffering change and the CI mitigation.

alex: closing loop here once CI green. tagging follow-ups: (#402 track, proxy patch PR #148).

sara: cheers — good catch everyone. :rocket:
